Help

What does the free plan include, and what does Pro add?

The free plan gives you 60 minutes a month for recordings and imports, keeps each recording for 15 days, writes 3 AI summaries a month and lets you copy any transcript. Pro and MAX replace the 60 minutes with transcription hours that reset every week or month, end the 15-day deletion, and add summaries for every recording, speaker detection, translation, AI Chat, sharing and export. MAX has twice the hours of Pro.

Free to download, with 60 minutes of transcription every month.

Included on the free plan too: Custom Vocabulary, automatic titles, meeting reminders, copying the text and live transcription. On Android, free and Pro use the same live transcription model. The app shows Pro’s price in your currency before you subscribe.

The 3 free summaries renew on the 1st of each month. Under every summary there’s a thumbs up and a thumbs down: after a thumbs-down, you can say what was wrong and have it written again, and the first such rewrite of a summary doesn’t use one of your 3.

Study (Pro, from version 1.6.0 on iPhone and 1.4.0 on Android): the Study tab of a recording turns its transcript into flashcards and a multiple-choice quiz, and every card and question quotes a passage from the recording. Creating a pack needs a connection; after that you can study offline, and the pack is kept on your phone with the recording. The cards and questions are made by AI: check them against the recording and your notes before an exam. The Study tab appears on recordings that have been transcribed and whose transcript isn’t very short; if none of your recordings shows it, the feature isn’t switched on in your app yet.

How do the 60 free minutes work?

  • Every recording you save counts with its full length, including recordings you save without transcribing. Imported files and YouTube videos count when you import them.
  • The minutes reset at the start of each calendar month, by your phone’s date. Unused minutes don’t carry over.
  • When they run out: on iPhone, a running recording stops, and an import that doesn’t fit is refused. On Android, you can’t start a new recording or use Upload File.
  • More on long recordings: how long a recording can be.

What happens after 15 days on the free plan?

  • Each recording is permanently deleted 15 days after its date: audio, transcript, summary, translation and chat. It doesn’t go to Deleted Recordings first.
  • About 2 days before, Verbi sends a notification, “Your recordings will be deleted soon”, if notifications are allowed. History also reminds you that the free plan keeps recordings 15 days.
  • To keep a recording, copy its text, or go Pro to export TXT or PDF and keep everything. See how to export.

Frequently asked questions

When do my free minutes reset?

At the start of each calendar month, by your phone’s date. Unused minutes don’t carry over.

Do recordings I don’t transcribe count?

Yes. Every saved recording counts with its full length, whether you transcribe it or not.

What happens to my recordings if I stay on the free plan?

Each one is permanently deleted 15 days after its date. Copy the text you want to keep, or go Pro to export TXT or PDF and keep everything.

More help articles

  • How do I export a transcript (copy, TXT, PDF)?On the free plan, use Copy Text. Verbi Pro adds sharing the transcript, summary or audio and export as TXT, PDF, DOCX (Word) or SRT subtitles.
  • How many hours do Pro and MAX include, and how are they counted?Pro and MAX include transcription hours that reset every week or month. Hours are the audio length sent for transcription; unused hours don’t roll over.
  • What happens when my Pro or MAX hours run out?Your recording is kept. The transcription waits until you add extra hours, switch to MAX or your hours reset; Verbi may transcribe the first part now.
  • What are extra hours, and how do they work?One-time packs of 5 or 15 hours for Pro and MAX. Extra hours never expire and stay yours after you cancel.
  • Where are my recordings stored, and who can see them?On your phone: Verbi has no account and no cloud sync. Audio is sent to be transcribed and text to OpenAI for AI features; our server doesn’t keep either.
  • How do I cancel Verbi Pro or restore a purchase?Cancel Verbi Pro in your App Store or Google Play subscriptions; Verbi has no cancel button. To get Pro back, tap Restore purchases in Verbi.
